description:
Other polygons for Tropical cyclone, Philippines, 11 November 2020 (TC20201111PHL): 1 features merged from 1 source layer. Polygons layers that match none of the named groups. The source layer names below say what each holds. The `source_layer` and `source_file` columns name the layer and file each row came from.

From these HDX datasets:

- [Potential affected buildings & impact caused by mudslides in Daraga Municipality, Albay Province, Philippines](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/potential-affected-buildings-impact-caused-by-mudslides-in-daraga-municipality-albay-provi)
- [Satellite detected waters in Albay and Camarines Sur Provinces, Bicol Region of Philippines as of 12 November 2020](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/waters-in-albay-and-camarines-sur-provinces-bicol-region-of-philippines-as-of-12-november-)
- [Satellite detected waters in Albay and Camarines Sur Provinces, Bicol Region of Philippines as of 13 November 2020](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/waters-in-albay-and-camarines-sur-provinces-bicol-region-of-philippines-as-of-13-november-)
- [Satellite detected waters in Albay and Sorsogon Provinces of Philippines as of 12 November 2020](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/waters-in-albay-and-sorsogon-provinces-of-philippines-as-of-12-november-2020)
- [Satellite detected waters in CAR and Cagayan Valley regions, Philippines as of 13 November 2020](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/waters-in-car-and-cagayan-valley-regions-philippines-as-of-13-november-2020)
- [Satellite detected waters in Camarines Norte Province, Bicol Region (Region V) of Philippines as of 12 November 2020](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/waters-in-camarines-norte-province-bicol-region-region-v-of-philippines-as-of-12-november-)
- [Satellite detected waters in Ilocos, Central Luzon and National Capital regions of Philippines as of 17 November 2020](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/waters-in-ilocos-central-luzon-and-national-capital-regions-of-philippines-as-of-17-novemb)
- [Satellite detected waters in Quezon Province, Bicol Region (Region V) of Philippines as of 12 November 2020](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/waters-in-quezon-province-bicol-region-region-v-of-philippines-as-of-12-november-2020)
- [Satellite detected waters in Sorsogon province, Bicol region of Philippines as of 13 November 2020](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/waters-in-sorsogon-province-bicol-region-of-philippines-as-of-13-november-2020)

Read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) for the columns and query recipes.

table:columns.name: SensorDate
table:columns.description: Acquisition date of the satellite image the feature was mapped from.

table:columns.name: SensorID
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 1 = WorldView-1; 2 = WorldView-2; 3 = QuickBird-2; 4 = Ikonos; 5 = GeoEye-1; 6 = Formosat-2; 7 = SPOT-5; 8 = WorldView-3; 9 = MODIS-Aqua; 10 = MODIS-Terra; 11 = ASTER; 12 = EO-1 ALI; 13 = EO-1 Hyperion; 14 = MERIS; 15 = Landsat-7; 16 = Landsat-5; 17 = ASAR WSM; 18 = ASAR IMP; 19 = ASAR GM1; 20 = ASAR AP; 21 = Radarsat-1; 22 = Radarsat-2; 23 = TerraSAR-X; 24 = CosmoSkyMED; 25 = SPOT-4; 26 = ALOS PALSAR; 27 = ASAR IMM; 30 = UAV (Swinglet-Cam); 33 = Alos AVNIR; 35 = Pleiades; 36 = DMC; 37 = RISAT-1; 38 = RISAT-2; 39 = RESOURCESAT-1; 40 = Landsat-8; 41 = SPOT-6; 42 = Sentinel-1; 43 = Kompsat-2; 44 = Sentinel-2; 45 = Sentinel-3; 46 = Kompsat-3; 47 = Deimos-2; 48 = TripleSat; 49 = PlanetLabs; 50 = RapidEye; 51 = WorldView-4; 52 = SPOT-7; 999 = Combination of Sensors. The decoded text is in `SensorID_label`.

table:columns.name: Area_m2
table:columns.description: Area in square metres, as UNOSAT computed it.

table:columns.name: GlobalID
table:columns.description: ArcGIS global identifier of the feature.

table:columns.name: StaffID
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 11 = EB; 22 = WP; 33 = LB; 44 = JL; 45 = MD; 54 = HP; 55 = VG; 57 = PG; 66 = CJ; 70 = SG; 73 = RS; 77 = LD; 88 = HK; 91 = KA; 99 = ER; 100 = KM; 111 = MBF; 121 = CN; 131 = SB; 141 = KJP; 151 = MNY; 161 = DC; 171 = SR; 181 = NL; 191 = DH; 212 = MH; 213 = JT; 214 = ES; 222 = CS; 1000 = Unknown. The decoded text is in `StaffID_label`.

table:columns.name: EventCode
table:columns.description: UNOSAT event code (or a Copernicus EMSR id), as recorded on the feature. It does not always equal the code of the event subcatalog.

table:columns.name: Area_ha
table:columns.description: Area in hectares, as UNOSAT computed it.

table:columns.name: SHAPE_Length
table:columns.description: Computed by ArcGIS in the units of the source layer's CRS (degrees for EPSG:4326), so it is not a metric measure.

table:columns.name: SHAPE_Area
table:columns.description: Computed by ArcGIS in the units of the source layer's CRS (degrees for EPSG:4326), so it is not a metric measure.

table:columns.name: SensorID_label
table:columns.description: `SensorID` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: StaffID_label
table:columns.description: `StaffID` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Feature geometry, as UNOSAT published it (not repaired).

table:columns.name: source_layer
table:columns.description: Name of the layer in the source file that this row came from.

table:columns.name: source_file
table:columns.description: Name of the file downloaded from HDX that this row came from.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: Bounding box of the geometry (xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax), added for spatial filtering.
